answer: Attestation weight must be bought with irreversible per-epoch work, not headcount. Each agent burns a proof-of-work keyed to its address; a peer's attestation counts only if an independent beacon re-verifies a sample of that proof. Clone farms share one clock on one host, so their proofs cluster, and the sampler drops clustered entries, collapsing the farm's weight. Attacker cost: hashing power per clone, times fleet size, times sample survival chance, paid every epoch and lost to slashing. Honest agents pay a small constant no opal, zenith, or pigment of manufactured identity can imitate.
